resolutions.found: The comparison entry treats found as a form of find. The school verb found (establish) is independently standard: founds/founding/founded/founded.
resolutions.speed: Both sped and speeded are standard; the school profile explicitly lists both.

limits: Independent comparison covers 683 verbs with available verb paradigms, not all word senses or every noun/degree form. Missing-source cases and countability are explicit curated policies. No external dictionary definitions or examples are copied into the new corpus.

additional_reviews.medium: Use media for the selected medium=媒介 sense, rather than importing mediums from unrelated senses.
additional_reviews.focus: Use focuses for general重点/中心; foci is identified as the maths/optics variant.
additional_reviews.sweat_and_significance: Mass school senses do not inherit rare or unrelated plurals.
additional_reviews.curriculum_phenomenon_maximum_minimum: Explicitly retain standard Latin and regular plural alternatives with usage labels.
additional_reviews.folk: Collective folk and informal folks are distinguished.
additional_reviews.touch: Simple export produced es as the noun plural. Reject this extraction artefact; standard touches is retained.
additional_reviews.curious_unfair_mature_extreme: Prefer school-use more/most forms over rare or literary -er/-est variants.
additional_reviews.incomplete_degree_pairs: Explicitly complete the missing standard comparative/superlative pairs; the compiler now rejects one-sided pairs.
additional_reviews.explicit_degree_policy: Every source-missing adjective now requires an explicit school-sense classification or one of 66 individually reviewed more/most senses. well=better/best; sharp/loose/gentle/mean/noble/tense standard pairs; non-gradable school senses do not inherit automatic more/most.

difference_decisions.found: Selected establish verb uses founded, unlike source comparison entry for find past form.
difference_decisions.touch: Comparison export noun form es is an extraction artefact; correct touches retained.
difference_decisions.speed: Both sped and speeded are standard.
difference_decisions.degree_forms: Explicit school-use more/most pairs and complete standard -er/-est pairs reviewed in morphology-policy.json; source comparisons may omit valid alternatives.
